title: Type clipboard history as keystrokes with Ctrl+Enter
head: 4e18ce8df23b

decision: publishable pending outer-assistant freshness and posting authorization

leads.summary: History entries ending in LF lose their trailing newlines when copied or typed
leads.consequence: Command substitution trims every trailing LF from jq output; both the existing history paste/copy path and the new Ctrl+Return path operate on the shortened text. A copied `hello\n\n` becomes `hello` on the clipboard and in wtype stdin, silently altering multi-line snippets. Preserve the bytes without command substitution (or restore the suffix from an explicit length) and assert exact file bytes rather than shell command-substitution comparisons.

leads.summary: Ctrl+Return on file-URI clipboard rows types the URI instead of the pathname shown as selected
leads.consequence: displayRows labels URI-list text as a file and renders its decoded filesystem pathname, but typeSelected excludes only images and calls the helper by history index. The helper types the original encoded `file:///...` URI (minus terminal LF), not the `/...` path the picker shows. For a file whose name has spaces, the injected bytes are not the path the user selected. Decide whether file rows should paste/copy rather than type, or pass the intended decoded pathname.
leads.triage: file-URI entry typed as raw file:// text: coordinator verified existing applySelected paste also uses raw history text via --history-index (Clipboard.qml at head 267-275), so consistent with existing paste, not PR-specific; dropped

leads.summary: Closing the overlay deletes a user's existing Ctrl+Return compositor binding
leads.consequence: On each open the PR installs a global Ctrl+Return binding; on close it runs `hl.unbind("CTRL + RETURN")`. Arch's Hyprland 0.56.2 implements unbind as removeKeybind(displayKey), which erases every matching bind, not only the newly registered one. A user-configured Ctrl+Return binding is lost after using the clipboard overlay until the Hyprland config reloads, and can be shadowed while the overlay is up. Avoid modifying a global key in this way; even the returned bind handle's remove() in Hyprland 0.56.2 erases binds sharing its modifier/key, rather than one uniquely identified object.
leads.triage: unbind removes user binds incl. handle remove() on 0.56.2: corroborates Opus F3

leads.summary: The new typing path silently loses non-ASCII characters under a C locale
leads.consequence: wtype v0.4 reads stdin byte by byte, calls setlocale(LC_CTYPE, ""), converts with mbstowcs, and skips invalid multibyte sequences. With LC_ALL=C, UTF-8 clipboard text cannot be decoded; repeated invalid bytes may exhaust the 8-byte buffer and stop typing the rest of the entry. The helper ignores wtype failure and stderr, returning success. Require a UTF-8 locale for typing or report failure, and test exact stdin/typed output with Unicode under LC_ALL=C as well as a UTF-8 locale. This is source-traced, not tested with a live compositor.
leads.triage: non-UTF-8 locale drops Unicode in wtype: source-only edge, Omarchy sessions use UTF-8; dropped

leads.summary: The new typing test passes even if wtype is sent no text
leads.consequence: The wtype stub records only `$*`, while the new assertions compare clipboard bytes and the literal argument string `-d 50 -`. The fixture also removes the trailing newline before storing it in JSON via command substitution in its `--arg text` argument. Replacing the helper's new pipe with `printf '%s' '' | wtype -d 50 -` still passes the whole clipboard test under LC_ALL=C. Capture stub stdin and assert its bytes against the stored JSON text, including trailing LF; the current checks cannot catch missing or truncated keystrokes.
leads.triage: wtype stub argv-only: corroborates Opus test-validity note; published as optional test improvement

leads.summary: The PR conflicts at the helper and test changes with open #12801's clipboard MIME fix
leads.consequence: Open #12801 changes the original `jq ... | wl-copy` line to set explicit `text/plain;charset=utf-8` MIME and adjusts clipboard fixture assertions. This PR replaces that same helper line with a command substitution and a bare `wl-copy`; a three-way merge against the common ancestor produces conflict markers in both helper and test. Resolve manually so both the new typing path and explicit MIME survive, otherwise a winner-takes-all merge either drops typing text or loses the MIME fix. #12801 was MERGEABLE against current quattro but diverged from this head.
leads.triage: conflict with #12801: corroborates Opus related-PR list; published

leads.summary: Potential stale Control-held state when typing closes the picker without calling close()
leads.consequence: The typing action sets opened=false directly rather than calling close(), the only close path that clears ctrlHeld. If release happens after the exclusive-focus overlay hides, keyCatcher may not receive Keys.onReleased, leaving ctrlHeld=true. Opening again does not reset it, so plain Return can be treated as typing. Confirm with a compositor-backed sequence (hold Ctrl+Return, release Control after overlay hides, reopen and press Return) before publishing as a runtime defect; reset ctrlHeld on every hide/open transition.

leads.summary: Open #11920 changes the selected-entry schema, so the new type branch requires integration
leads.consequence: Open #11920 adds `largetext` clipboard rows and replaces ordinary text history-index actions with snapshots over `--stdin`. This PR's typeSelected checks only `image`, so a largetext row would take the `--type --history-index` text-only helper path, whose `.type == "text"` guard rejects it, instead of the other PR's file-backed paste path. Both changed the same QML action area (three-way conflict); when resolving, route large text deliberately and adapt typing of ordinary text to the selected snapshot. This is a conditional integration risk until the conflicting branches are reconciled.
leads.triage: #11920/#12991 overlap (hypothesis): in Opus related-PR list; published briefly

limits: No live compositor or desktop slot was assigned; Ctrl-release delivery after overlay hide and Hyprland binding callbacks were not exercised. B3 is settled from Hyprland source, B7 remains explicitly conditional.

For related PRs with conflicts, no resolved combined implementation exists to run; no claim of a successful merge or combined test pass is made for #12801/#11920. Current quattro's independent clean merge and stubbed tests were checked separately.

comment:
## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Outcome:** The helper now strips trailing newlines from every history paste and copy, not only typing.

### Return and Shift+Return lose trailing newlines

`text=$(jq -j ...)` drops trailing newlines and NUL bytes before `wl-copy` on every `--history-index` path. **Impact:** `echo hi\n` is now pasted or copied as `echo hi`.

**Suggested change:** keep the direct `jq -j ... | wl-copy` pipe and read `text` only for `--type`.

<details><summary>Reproducer (fails at 4e18ce8)</summary>

Reviewed head: 4e18ce8df23bdc7fddc8e7c3472d8b5234068db2. Base for comparison: 692c02cad5c1ee90fe4188cc2be48e534cbe6e62 (merge base).

Cause: `copy_history_entry` now reads the entry with `text=$(jq -j ...)` and copies `printf '%s' "$text" | wl-copy`. Command substitution strips every trailing newline and bash drops NUL bytes, so the bytes put on the clipboard by the existing paste (`--shift-insert --history-index`) and copy (`--copy-only --history-index`) paths change. The base piped `jq -j ... | wl-copy` directly.

## Test (append to `test/shell.d/clipboard-test.sh`, after the existing helper tests)

It uses the file's own `wl-copy`/`wtype` stubs and `$TMPDIR` layout.

```bash
# Return and Shift+Return put the history entry on the clipboard byte for
# byte, including its trailing newline.
jq -n '[{type:"text", text:"echo hi\n"}]' >"$TMPDIR/home/.local/state/omarchy/clipboard-history.json"
for flag in --shift-insert --copy-only; do
  rm -f "$TMPDIR/copied"
  WL_COPY_OUT="$TMPDIR/copied" WTYPE_OUT="$TMPDIR/wtype" HOME="$TMPDIR/home" PATH="$TMPDIR/bin:$PATH" \
    "$ROOT/bin/omarchy-clipboard-paste-text" "$flag" --history-index 0
  cmp -s "$TMPDIR/copied" <(printf 'echo hi\n') ||
    fail "clipboard paste helper $flag keeps the entry's trailing newline" "copied bytes: $(od -An -c "$TMPDIR/copied")"
  pass "clipboard paste helper $flag keeps the entry's trailing newline"
done
```

Run: `bash test/shell.d/clipboard-test.sh`

## Actual output

At the PR head (last lines; exit 1):

```
ok - clipboard open helper opens image entries in Tensaku
copied bytes:    e   c   h   o       h   i
not ok - clipboard paste helper --shift-insert keeps the entry's trailing newline
```

At the merge base (exit 0):

```
ok - clipboard paste helper --shift-insert keeps the entry's trailing newline
ok - clipboard paste helper --copy-only keeps the entry's trailing newline
```

The PR head merged into current `quattro` fails the same way. With the head helper changed to keep the direct pipe for the copy and read the text separately only for `--type` (below), the whole file passes, including the PR's new `--type` assertions:

```diff
-  text=$(jq -j --argjson index "$history_index" '.[$index].text' "$history_path")
-  printf '%s' "$text" | wl-copy
+  jq -j --argjson index "$history_index" '.[$index].text' "$history_path" | wl-copy
+  if [[ $type_keys == "true" ]]; then
+    text=$(jq -j --argjson index "$history_index" '.[$index].text' "$history_path")
+  fi
```

## Byte-level comparison (helper run with recording stubs, same history entry)

| Entry text (JSON) | Mode | Base wl-copy bytes | Head wl-copy bytes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `"echo hi\n"` | `--shift-insert --history-index 0` | `65 63 68 6f 20 68 69 0a` | `65 63 68 6f 20 68 69` |
| `"echo hi\n"` | `--copy-only --history-index 0` | `65 63 68 6f 20 68 69 0a` | `65 63 68 6f 20 68 69` |
| `"a\n\n\n"` | `--copy-only --history-index 0` | `61 0a 0a 0a` | `61` |
| `"foo<NUL>bar"` | `--copy-only --history-index 0` | `66 6f 6f 00 62 61 72` | `66 6f 6f 62 61 72` (stderr: `warning: command substitution: ignored null byte in input`) |
| `"line one\r\nline two\r\n"` | `--copy-only --history-index 0` | `... 74 77 6f 0d 0a` | `... 74 77 6f 0d` |

(`<NUL>` stands for the JSON escape for U+0000.) The existing assertions cannot see this: the fixture entry is built with `"$(printf '...\n')"` (already stripped) and compared with `$(<file)` (strips again).
</details>

### Closing the overlay removes user Ctrl+Return binds

`hl.unbind("CTRL + RETURN")` removes every bind spelled `CTRL + RETURN` in Hyprland 0.56.2 and main (from source, not run). **Impact:** a user's own such bind is lost on the first close until a config reload; after a shell crash while open, Ctrl+Return stays captured until the next open and close.

**Suggested change:** create one disabled bind in Lua config and toggle it with `set_enabled` (see Details).

<details><summary>More findings: overlay state after Ctrl+Return, rebase onto current quattro</summary>

#### Ctrl+Return leaves overlay state set for the next open

Ctrl+Return hides the overlay with `opened = false`, bypassing `close()`, so `ctrlHeld` and `clearConfirmOpen` survive, and `typeCurrent()` ignores the delete confirmation. **Impact:** a later Return or Shift+Return can type instead of paste or copy, and Ctrl+Return during "Delete entire clipboard history?" types the entry and leaves that dialog armed.

**Suggested change:** reset both flags when `opened` becomes false and return early from `typeCurrent()` while `clearConfirmOpen` is set.

#### The bare `IpcHandler` fails `shell-ipc-socket-test.sh` after a merge with `quattro`

`quattro` now requires first-party IPC handlers to use `ShellIpc` (#13435). Merged into the current tip, the PR's `IpcHandler` makes `test/shell.d/shell-ipc-socket-test.sh` fail; it still works at runtime through the slower `qs ipc` fallback. **Impact:** an existing test fails after the merge, which is otherwise conflict-free.

**Suggested change:** declare the handler as `ShellIpc { target: "omarchy.clipboard"; ... }` when rebasing; the PR's own assertion still matches.

</details>

<details><summary>Reproducer: Control state (fails at 4e18ce8, headless QML harness)</summary>

Reviewed head: 4e18ce8df23bdc7fddc8e7c3472d8b5234068db2.

Cause: `Keys.onPressed` sets `ctrlHeld = true` on the Control press and only `Keys.onReleased` (or `close()`) clears it. Ctrl+Return hides the overlay through `typeSelected()`, which sets `root.opened = false` directly and does not go through `close()`. If Control is still held when the overlay hides (the usual case), the release goes to the window that regains focus. `open()` does not reset the flag. On the next open, `wantsType()` returns true for any Return, and the Return branch checks `wantsType` before Shift, so Return and Shift+Return both call `--type`.

When it shows: the next open gets no Control release, for example via `omarchy menu clipboard`, a user binding without Ctrl, or a quick Super+Ctrl+V tap that is released before the overlay has focus. Escape, a click outside the card, or Super+Ctrl+V to close go through `close()` and clear it.

## Harness

Headless Qt Quick Test (`qmltestrunner`, `QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen`, Qt 6.11.2) loading the PR's `Clipboard.qml` and `ClipboardHistory.js` unchanged except for removing the four `PanelWindow` lines that only exist under Quickshell (`anchors { top: true; ... }` and three `WlrLayershell.*` attached properties). `Quickshell`, `Quickshell.Io`, `qs.Commons` and `qs.Ui` are test doubles: `Quickshell.execDetached` records argv instead of running anything, `PanelWindow` is a plain `Item`, `ConfirmDialog.handleKey` is copied verbatim. Key events are sent with QtTest's `keyPress`/`keyClick`.

The test models the PR's main path: the overlay receives the Control press, Return is consumed by the compositor `CTRL + RETURN` bind, which calls `typeCurrent()` over IPC.

```qml
function test_08_return_after_compositor_ctrl_return_pastes() {
  openWithHistory()                       // two text entries, c.open("{}")
  keyPress(Qt.Key_Control)                // Control reaches the overlay
  compare(c.typeCurrent(), "ok")          // Return taken by the compositor bind
  compare(helperLog()[0], "--type --history-index 0")

  Quickshell.reset()
  c.open("{}"); wait(50)                  // reopened without a Control key event
  keyClick(Qt.Key_Return, Qt.ShiftModifier)
  compare(helperLog()[0], "--copy-only --history-index 0", "Shift+Return copies on the next open")
}
```

(`helperLog()` lists the arguments of every recorded `omarchy-clipboard-*` helper call.)

## Actual output at the PR head

```
QDEBUG : qmltestrunner::ClipboardTypeKeys::test_08_return_after_compositor_ctrl_return_pastes() qml: OBSERVED Shift+Return on next open: ["--type --history-index 0"]
FAIL!  : qmltestrunner::ClipboardTypeKeys::test_08_return_after_compositor_ctrl_return_pastes() Shift+Return copies on the next open
   Actual   (): --type --history-index 0
   Expected (): --copy-only --history-index 0
```

The same test with a plain `keyClick(Qt.Key_Return)` on the next open (expecting the paste call):

```
QDEBUG : qmltestrunner::ClipboardTypeKeys::test_08b_plain_return_after_compositor_ctrl_return_pastes() qml: OBSERVED plain Return on next open (compositor path): ["--type --history-index 0"]
FAIL!  : qmltestrunner::ClipboardTypeKeys::test_08b_plain_return_after_compositor_ctrl_return_pastes() plain Return pastes on the next open
   Actual   (): --type --history-index 0
   Expected (): --shift-insert --history-index 0
```

Same results with the PR merged into current `quattro` (where the overlay is an `OverlayWindow`).

With `ctrlHeld` (and `clearConfirmOpen`) reset when `opened` becomes false, both pass:

```
QDEBUG : qmltestrunner::ClipboardTypeKeys::test_08_return_after_compositor_ctrl_return_pastes() qml: OBSERVED Shift+Return on next open: ["--copy-only --history-index 0"]
PASS   : qmltestrunner::ClipboardTypeKeys::test_08_return_after_compositor_ctrl_return_pastes()
QDEBUG : qmltestrunner::ClipboardTypeKeys::test_08b_plain_return_after_compositor_ctrl_return_pastes() qml: OBSERVED plain Return on next open (compositor path): ["--shift-insert --history-index 0"]
PASS   : qmltestrunner::ClipboardTypeKeys::test_08b_plain_return_after_compositor_ctrl_return_pastes()
```

Candidate change used for that run:

```diff
-  onOpenedChanged: root.setTypeBind(root.opened)
+  onOpenedChanged: {
+    if (!root.opened) {
+      root.ctrlHeld = false
+      root.clearConfirmOpen = false
+    }
+    root.setTypeBind(root.opened)
+  }
```

Limit: the harness cannot model the compositor moving keyboard focus away (in the harness, a hidden item still receives key events), so the "Control release is not delivered" step is represented by not sending it. The test does not run Hyprland or Quickshell.
</details>

<details><summary>Reproducer: delete confirmation (fails at 4e18ce8, headless QML harness)</summary>

Reviewed head: 4e18ce8df23bdc7fddc8e7c3472d8b5234068db2.

Cause: while the overlay is open the compositor `CTRL + RETURN` bind is active, so Ctrl+Return never reaches QML; it calls `typeCurrent()` over IPC. `typeCurrent()` checks `opened` and the row count but not `clearConfirmOpen` (the PR's `Shortcut` is disabled while the confirmation is open, the IPC path is not). `typeSelected()` hides the overlay with `root.opened = false`, which skips `close()` and therefore `cancelClearHistory()`. `open()` does not reset `clearConfirmOpen`, so the next open shows the confirmation again with Delete preselected (`requestClearHistory()` sets `selectedIndex = 1`).

## Harness

Same headless Qt Quick Test harness as the Control-state reproducer: the PR's `Clipboard.qml` with Quickshell-only `PanelWindow` lines removed, test doubles for `Quickshell`, `Quickshell.Io`, `qs.Commons`, `qs.Ui` (`ConfirmDialog.handleKey` copied verbatim), `Quickshell.execDetached` recording argv only.

```qml
function test_09_ctrl_return_in_clear_confirm() {
  openWithHistory()                             // two text entries, c.open("{}")
  keyClick(Qt.Key_Delete, Qt.ShiftModifier)     // "Delete entire clipboard history?"
  compare(c.clearConfirmOpen, true)
  var result = c.typeCurrent()                  // Ctrl+Return, taken by the compositor bind
  var typedDuringConfirm = helperLog().length
  if (!c.opened) {
    c.open("{}"); wait(50)                      // next normal open
    keyClick(Qt.Key_Return)
  }
  compare(typedDuringConfirm, 0, "Ctrl+Return does not type while the delete confirmation is open")
  compare(c.history.length, 2, "history survives")
}
```

## Actual output at the PR head

```
QDEBUG : qmltestrunner::ClipboardTypeKeys::test_09_ctrl_return_in_clear_confirm() qml: OBSERVED typeCurrent during confirm: ok ["--type --history-index 0"] opened=false clearConfirmOpen=true
QDEBUG : qmltestrunner::ClipboardTypeKeys::test_09_ctrl_return_in_clear_confirm() qml: OBSERVED next open: clearConfirmOpen=true
QDEBUG : qmltestrunner::ClipboardTypeKeys::test_09_ctrl_return_in_clear_confirm() qml: OBSERVED after Return on next open: history length=0 ["--type --history-index 0"]
FAIL!  : qmltestrunner::ClipboardTypeKeys::test_09_ctrl_return_in_clear_confirm() Ctrl+Return does not type while the delete confirmation is open
   Actual   (): 1
   Expected (): 0
```

So the entry is typed into the previously focused window while the modal confirmation is showing, the confirmation is still open on the next launch, and a plain Return there clears the whole history. Same result with the PR merged into current `quattro`.

With `if (root.clearConfirmOpen) return "confirming"` in `typeCurrent()` (plus resetting `clearConfirmOpen` when `opened` becomes false), the test passes:

```
QDEBUG : qmltestrunner::ClipboardTypeKeys::test_09_ctrl_return_in_clear_confirm() qml: OBSERVED typeCurrent during confirm: confirming [] opened=true clearConfirmOpen=true
PASS   : qmltestrunner::ClipboardTypeKeys::test_09_ctrl_return_in_clear_confirm()
```

Limit: the compositor bind is represented by calling `typeCurrent()` directly; Hyprland and Quickshell IPC are not run. That Hyprland consumes a matching bind's key press (so QML does not also see it) is from Hyprland source (`CKeybindManager::handleKeybinds`: a non-`non_consuming` bind sets `found = true`, so the event is not passed to the client).
</details>

<details><summary>Reproducer: rebase onto quattro (fails on the merge)</summary>

Reviewed head: 4e18ce8df23bdc7fddc8e7c3472d8b5234068db2. `quattro` tip: 8b4eae66da2938ba9559f103b18dbf85cdf28a70.

`quattro` gained `shell/Commons/ShellIpc.qml` (an `IpcHandler` that also registers with `IpcRegistry`, so `omarchy-shell` can answer over the shell's own socket, #13435) and a test that every first-party handler uses it. The PR adds a bare `IpcHandler { target: "omarchy.clipboard" ... }` to `shell/plugins/clipboard/Clipboard.qml`. The merge is textually clean.

## Steps

(Not run as written: the review built the equivalent clean merge in its own clone and ran the test there.)

```bash
git fetch origin quattro pull/11701/head:pr-11701
git checkout --detach origin/quattro
git merge --no-edit pr-11701          # merges without conflicts
bash test/shell.d/shell-ipc-socket-test.sh
```

## Actual output (last lines; exit 1)

```
ok - a stale socket with nothing listening falls back to qs ipc
ok - without the socket calls go through qs ipc
ok - a call for another display does not reach this shell's socket
expected: ["shell/Commons/IpcRegistry.qml","shell/Commons/ShellIpc.qml"]
```

</details>

<details><summary>Details</summary>

**Ctrl+Return bind mechanism.** In Hyprland 0.56.2 `hlUnbind` calls `CKeybindManager::removeKeybind(displayKeys)`, which erases every bind whose normalized display key matches, across submaps; Hyprland main does the same through `removeByDisplayKey`. While the overlay is open, a user's own Ctrl+Return bind also fires (0.56.2). `default/hypr/bindings/utilities.lua` (lines 48-49) already warns about unbinding by key. On 0.56.2 even a kept handle's `remove()` erases by modifier and key, so a disabled bind toggled with `set_enabled` is safer. Sketch (source-checked against 0.56.2 and main, not run):

```lua
omarchy_clipboard_type_bind = hl.bind("CTRL + RETURN", hl.dsp.exec_cmd("omarchy-shell -q omarchy.clipboard typeCurrent"), { description = "Type clipboard entry" })
omarchy_clipboard_type_bind:set_enabled(false)
```

QML then runs `hyprctl eval 'omarchy_clipboard_type_bind:set_enabled(true)'` on open and `(false)` on close. Disabled binds are skipped without consuming the key, and a config reload recreates the bind disabled.

**Verified**
- `wtype -d 50 -` types from stdin with a 50 ms delay (about 18 characters per second); leading-dash and non-ASCII text stays off argv.
- Invalid indexes (`abc`, `-1`, `99`) exit without copying; empty text types nothing; `--copy-only` takes precedence over `--type`.
- In the headless QML harness, Return pastes, Shift+Return copies, Ctrl+Return types once, `typeCurrent` follows the highlighted row, and bind and unbind pair up on Escape, paste, type and shell reload.
- The PR's clipboard tests pass at the head and merged into current `quattro`.

**Optional test improvements**
- The "Ctrl+Enter types the selected entry" assertion still passes when the Return branch calls `activateIndex`, because `[\s\S]*` reaches the `Shortcut`'s `typeIndex`; anchor it to the `Keys` branch.
